'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Gaza war]]
**[[Rafah offensive]]
***The [[Israel Defense Forces]] begins the expansion of the recently-established [[Morag Corridor]] [[buffer zone]] to include the [[Rafah Governorate|southern Gaza]] city of [[Rafah]], intending to connect it with the [[Philadelphi Corridor]]. Witnesses report the Israeli [[Israeli demolition of Palestinian property|demolition]] of structures in Rafah. [https://aje.io/sk8e1a?update=3649238 (Al Jazeera)] [https://newsukraine.rbc.ua/news/israel-intensifies-operation-in-gaza-strip-1744845608.html (RBC Ukraine)]
***At least 37 people, including children, are killed in a series of [[Israel]]i strikes against [[internal displacement|displaced]] [[Palestinians]] in the [[Gaza Strip]], according to the [[Palestinian Civil Defence]] agency. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c5yrl891j23o (BBC News)]
*[[Red Sea crisis]]
**[[March–April 2025 United States attacks in Yemen]]
***The [[United States Navy]] launches a wave of [[missile]] strikes across [[Houthi controlled territory of Yemen|Houthi-controlled]] [[Yemen]], killing at least one person in [[Sanaa]]. [https://apnews.com/article/yemen-houthis-us-airstrikes-israel-hamas-war-7d9f3288f71746df4aeed7ce41b5bb47 (AP)]
*[[Somali Civil War (2009–present)|Somali Civil War]]
**[[2025 Shabelle offensive]], [[American military intervention in Somalia (2007–present)|American military intervention in Somalia]]
***[[United States Armed Forces|U.S.]] [[airstrike]]s kill twelve [[Al-Shabaab (militant group)|al-Shabaab]] insurgents in central [[Somalia]], while a separate airstrike destroys an unflagged vessel suspected of carrying weapons for the militant group off the Somali coast. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/airstrike-army-attack-kill-dozens-al-shabaab-fighters-somalia-government-says-2025-04-17/ (Reuters)] [https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20250417-somali-us-air-strikes-kill-al-shabaab-fighters-hit-weapons-ship-says-government/ (Middle East Monitor)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[Kočani nightclub fire]]
**The death toll from the fire at a [[nightclub]] in [[Kočani]], [[North Macedonia]], in March increases to 62 as a [[burn]] victim dies in the hospital. [https://www.slobodenpecat.mk/pochina-24-godishniot-stojanche-stefanov-povreden-vo-pozharot-vo-kochani/ (Sloboden Pečat)]
*[[Monte Faito cable car crash]]
**Four people are killed and one is injured after the collapse of an [[aerial tramway]] on the [[Monte Faito]] in [[Campania]], [[Italy]]. [https://www.ilmessaggero.it/italia/monte_faito_funivia_incidente_cavo_rotto_precipita_cabina_passeggeri_ultime_notizie-8785431.html (''Il Messaggero'')]
*The death toll of the capsized Hong Hai 16 two days ago off [[Occidental Mindoro]], [[Philippines]], rises to four. Seven others are still missing. [https://www.pna.gov.ph/articles/1248317 (Philippine News Agency)]
*A [[middle school]] student is killed and several others are injured when a [[school bus]] returning from a field trip [[blowout (tire)|blows a tire]], strikes a [[guard rail]], and overturns on [[Interstate 77 in South Carolina|Interstate 77]] in [[Chester County, South Carolina|Chester County]], [[South Carolina]], United States. Two other buses travelling back from the field trip maneuvered to avoid crashing into it. Between the three buses, at least 35 students and four adults were injured. [https://abcnews.go.com/amp/US/school-bus-overturns-chester-county-south-carolina/story?id=120926898#amp_ct=1744936183826&amp_tf=From%20%251$s&aoh=17449361582666&referrer=https://www.google.com&amp_gsa=1&amp_js_v=a9&id=120926898&usqp=mq331AQIUAKwASCAAgM= (ABC News)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Tropic Air Flight 711]]
**A hijacker is killed and three others are injured when a [[United States|U.S.]] citizen [[aircraft hijacking|hijack]]s a [[Tropic Air]] [[Cessna 208 Caravan]] and attacks passengers with a [[knife]] before being fatally shot by a passenger with a [[firearm]] at [[Philip S. W. Goldson International Airport]] in [[Belize City]], [[Belize]]. [https://abcnews.go.com/International/american-citizen-hijacks-small-plane-belize-3-injured/story?id=120916154 (ABC News)] [https://www.airwaysmag.com/new-post/tropic-air-cessna-208-hijacked (''Airways'')]
*[[2025 Florida State University shooting]]
**At least two people are killed and six others are hospitalized in a  [[mass shooting]] at [[Florida State University]] in [[Tallahassee, Florida|Tallahassee]], [[Florida]], United States. The suspect is arrested by local police. [https://apnews.com/article/florida-state-university-shooter-alert-bf66a24ea91959697c7138089b2ef6fb (AP)] [https://www.nytimes.com/2025/04/17/us/fsu-shooting-tallahassee.html (''The New York Times'')] [https://www.nbcnews.com/news/us-news/live-blog/florida-state-university-active-shooter-rcna201756 (NBC News)]
*[[Illegal drug trade in Turkey]]
**[[Law enforcement in Turkey|Turkish police]] detain 525 suspected [[drug dealer]]s in [[Ankara]], in what is the biggest [[narcotics]] operation in the [[Turkey|country's]] history, involving thousands of officers, [[sniffer dog]]s, [[Use of unmanned aerial vehicles in law enforcement|drones]], and [[police aviation|helicopter]]s, according to the [[Ministry of the Interior (Turkey)|interior ministry]]. [https://apnews.com/article/turkey-drug-raids-arrests-ankara-4d3a67fc68fa197c9fb50f632ca4b14d (AP)] [https://www.turkiyetoday.com/turkiye/525-turkish-drug-dealers-detained-in-massive-raid-in-ankara-145920/ (''Türkiye Today'')]
*The [[State Administration Council|government]] of [[Myanmar]] [[pardon]]s and releases 4,893 prisoners, including thirteen foreigners who will be [[deportation|deported]] from the country, and 22 [[political prisoner]]s, ahead of the country's [[Thingyan|New Year]]. [https://www.dw.com/en/myanmar-junta-pardons-4900-prisoners-to-mark-new-year/a-72271886 (DW)] [https://www.rfa.org/english/myanmar/2025/04/17/myanmar-new-year-amnesty-release/ (Radio Free Asia)]
*Two people are severely injured in a [[stabbing attack]] at an [[Aldi]] supermarket in [[Rochlitz]], [[Saxony]], [[Germany]]. [https://www.dw.com/en/germany-rochlitz-supermarket-stabbing-leaves-2-injured/a-72284065 (DW)]
